subject: SI Partner Kickstart — Launch, Labs & Certification Timeline
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@cloudbridge.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: partner-ops@cloudbridge.com
Date: Sat, 15 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partnership kickoff: CloudBridge x Redwood SI program

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for taking time at Re:Connect last week — the CloudBridge team left excited about the potential to jointly certify Systems Integrators (SIs) to deploy Redwood Inference for their customers. We put together a short kickstart brief and a suggested 90-day program (attached).

High level ask: would Redwood run a 2-hour kickoff + 3 technical labs (2-hour each) and provide a certification check at the end? Our initial cohort is 12 consultants across three practices (platform, data/ML, and apps) and we'd like to schedule the kickoff week of July 24.

Attachments: CB-Partner-Kickstart-1pager.pdf (1 page), draft-cohort-list.csv (csv)

Proposed times (PT): 
- Tue Jul 25 10:00–12:00 PT (kickoff)
- Wed Jul 26 10:00–12:00 PT (Lab 1: Serving basics)
- Thu Jul 27 10:00–12:00 PT (Lab 2: Performance & batching)
- Fri Jul 28 10:00–12:00 PT (Lab 3: Private deploys & security)

Can you confirm Redwood capacity to run training and who from your side would lead each lab? Also happy to adapt the agenda to your recommendations.

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Principal Partner Manager
CloudBridge Consulting

On attachments: see CB-Partner-Kickstart-1pager.pdf attached.
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Jul 2028 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership kickoff: CloudBridge x Redwood SI program

Hi Alicia — great to hear and thanks for the brief. We can run the program and I like the proposed cadence. Quick confirmations and asks: 

1) Kickoff timing: Tue Jul 25 10:00–12:00 PT works for us. Please send a calendar invite with dial-in + Miro board link.
2) Cohort size: 12 is fine; we'll cap at 15. Please send the cohort list (roles & email) by EOD Jul 20 so we can provision accounts.
3) Leads: Ben will own Lab 1 & 2 (serving runtime, batching, quantization); Marissa will lead Lab 3 (private deployment, security). I'll run the kickoff and handle partner ops.

I attached a kickoff agenda I suggest we use and a short pre-read that will speed up the technical labs. We typically ask participants to complete the 30-min pre-read and a one-page questionnaire before Lab 1.

Attachments: 20280715-kickoff-agenda.pdf (agenda), SI-training-modules-v1.pdf (internal modules)

If that all sounds good I'll lock calendar invites and send pre-read reminders.

Thanks — excited to get this cohort certified.

— Evelyn Hart
Head of Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
Evelyn_Hart@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Jul 2028 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership kickoff: CloudBridge x Redwood SI program (internal)

Eve / Marissa — couple of operational notes from infra/training side: 

- Lab 1 (Serving basics): I'll cover runtime topology, model variants, and simple inference demos. Need 45 min live demo + 30 min hands-on.
- Lab 2 (Perf & batching): I'll include continuous batching, KV cache notes, and quantization tradeoffs. We should bring one benchmark (gpt-like) and one embeddings use case.
- Lab 3 (Private deploys & security): Marissa, can you lead the KMS/HSM and VPC networking bits? Also cover audit logs and data retention policies. 

Operational asks: 
- We need access provisioning list by Jul 20 (email + role).
- Recommend single-test project per cohort to avoid quota collisions; I'll prepare a provisioning script.
- Certification: propose a 30-minute practical test + 20 Q multiple choice. We can run the practical on the afternoon of Jul 28.

I'll attach the draft training modules for review. Please flag anything that needs changing before we share with CloudBridge.

Attachment: SI-training-modules-v1.pdf (8 pages)

- Ben
Training Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@cloudbridge.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudBridge Partner Ops <partner-ops@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership kickoff: CloudBridge x Redwood SI program

Thanks — all good from our side. Sending the cohort list and a short NDA-lite for training artifacts (attached). A few clarifications: 

- Cohort composition: 5 platform engineers, 4 data/ML engineers, 3 apps consultants. Names attached in cohort-list.csv.
- Training environment: Good to know about the single-test project — please send the provisioning script and we will create accounts by Jul 22.
- Exam: CloudBridge would like two certification tiers (associate/practitioner). Can Redwood run both in the same week? We can distribute the associate exam after Lab 2 and practitioner after Lab 3.

Attachments: cohort-list.csv (roster), CB-training-nda.pdf (pdf)

Alicia
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership kickoff: CloudBridge x Redwood SI program

Hi Alicia — confirmed. Final plan below and action owners (TL;DR): 

Final timeline (PT):
- Tue Jul 25, 10:00–12:00 — Kickoff (Evelyn) — agenda attached
- Wed Jul 26, 10:00–12:00 — Lab 1 (Ben) — serving, demos, hands-on
- Thu Jul 27, 10:00–12:00 — Lab 2 (Ben) — performance, batching, quantization
- Fri Jul 28, 14:00–16:00 — Lab 3 + practitioner exam (Marissa) — private deploys, security, audit logs
- Fri Jul 28, 16:30–17:00 — Certification debrief & next steps (all)

Action items: 
- CloudBridge: send final cohort list and calendar RSVPs (Alicia) — due Jul 20
- Redwood Training: provisioning script + test project (Ben) — due Jul 22
- Redwood Security: exam proctoring + practitioner blueprint (Marissa) — due Jul 24
- Legal: return NDA-lite signature (Alicia/CB legal) — due Jul 22

Attachments included: 20280715-kickoff-agenda.pdf, SI-training-modules-v1.pdf

I'll send calendar invites with Zoom links and a Miro board by EOD tomorrow. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Evelyn
Head of Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
[calendar invite attached: CloudBridge-SI-Kickstart.ics]
